component.name: deepDolphin
deepDolphin 面板
component.summary: Project-group progress panel for moonGit repositories

description.p: deepDolphin is the deepin/DDE client for the moonGit engine. It shows the progress of every registered repository at a glance — KPI cards, language coverage, milestone state, branch pulses and commit composition — and drives the engine for updates, git operations and milestone management.
deepDolphin 是 moonGit 引擎的 deepin/DDE 客户端：一眼看全项目群的进度（KPI 卡片、 语言分布、里程碑、工程脉搏、提交构成），并对接引擎完成更新、git 操作与里程碑管理。 AI 摘要与 AI 助手在客户端本地完成，未配置时如实降级。

ul.li: Four views: dashboard, board, milestones, project detail.
Shallow/deep updates, single project or the whole group, with optional AI digests.
Tray quick-look popup and system notifications.
DTK native, light/dark and font-size aware.

description.p: First deepin/DDE release: DTK native, engine discovery, AI integrations.
首个 deepin/DDE 版本：DTK 原生、引擎发现、AI 整合。
